card.name: "the" before southeastern US place names
card.fires_on: The word "the" (sometimes "at" or a comma) right before a region or place name in the southeastern United States, such as the Southern Mountains, Cumberland mountains, Great Smoky Mountains or southeastern USA.

modes.label: "the" before a regional name
modes.description: The word "the" after "of", "in" or "crossed", just before a southern or Appalachian region.
modes.example: hiking in<< the>> Great Smoky Mountains.

modes.label: Other linking words before a place
modes.description: A comma, "at" or "Greater" that comes just before a southern place name or institution.
modes.example: the coast<<,>> mountains, the sounds or the ocean

card.writes: It pushes toward place-name starts such as Guil, Ventura and Great, as in Great Smoky or Guilford.
card.plain: It fires on small words like "the" when a southeastern US place name, such as the Smoky Mountains, is about to come next.
